report_title: Service Level Objective (SLO) Architecture Specification Report

active_slos.name: Ingress API Availability
active_slos.description: 99.9% of HTTP requests return non-5xx status codes over rolling 30 days.
active_slos.business_purpose: Ensure platform is continuously reachable for document submission.

active_slos.name: API Ingress P95 Latency
active_slos.description: 95% of synchronous API requests complete within 500ms.
active_slos.business_purpose: Maintain rapid interactive experience for document upload and status probes.

active_slos.name: PostgreSQL Transaction Reliability
active_slos.description: 99.95% of database transactions complete successfully with P95 < 50ms.
active_slos.business_purpose: Guarantee document metadata consistency and persistence without data loss.

active_slos.name: Queue Ingestion & Dispatch Latency
active_slos.description: 99.0% of document jobs wait less than 2.0s in Redis queue prior to worker pickup.
active_slos.business_purpose: Prevent backlog starvation and guarantee real-time ingestion SLA.

active_slos.name: Worker Task Execution Success
active_slos.description: 99.5% of background worker tasks finish without unhandled fatal exceptions.
active_slos.business_purpose: Ensure predictable, fault-tolerant asynchronous document processing.

active_slos.name: Gemini Extraction Availability & Success
active_slos.description: 99.0% of Gemini AI inferences return valid structured extractions within 4.0s.
active_slos.business_purpose: Provide highly reliable document entity extraction without schema failures.

active_slos.name: OCR Text Recognition Reliability
active_slos.description: 98.5% of multi-page documents recognized without unrecoverable OCR errors.
active_slos.business_purpose: Ensure clean tokenization and text extraction from raw document scans.

active_slos.name: Artifact Storage Persistence Reliability
active_slos.description: 99.99% of document artifact read and write operations succeed without corruption.
active_slos.business_purpose: Guarantee immutable artifact storage and rapid download retrieval.
